application_conditions: Publishers/creators with a qualifying website or app, or customers with a trader network; apply at affiliates.bybit.com; approval by Bybit team.
paid_action: Share of trading-fee profit (fees − maker rebates − bonuses) from referred users who actively trade.
validation_conditions: Referred users receiving other Bybit rebates/incentives may not count; relationship may end after 180 days without trading.

commission.model_note: Standard base rate not published; VIP accounts capped at 50% total rebate; Master-affiliate override 10% of sub-affiliate rebate. Card not mentioned as commissionable.

payout.method: Affiliate Portal → Bybit account → external wallet

rules_note: Page dated 2026-09-19. EU entity (Bybit EU) status for affiliates not stated; EEA card is a separate Bybit EU product.
